notes.title: Incredible battlefield
notes.content:
Build your own level foreword:
Recently, there have been a number of frequent small updates, no timely release of notice, to say sorry (> ﹏ <). )
This time, it will be released together
EA version has been released for a whole year
It was planned to develop for 6 months to a year, but now it is just beginning to find some pleasure. At present, it is planned to keep updating
At present, more than 50% of the game's ideas come from the suggestions of various players, and some people's ideas can be realized. I think the existence of this game has some value
Loyal thanks to the EA version, the game is still very simple to support the players, bow ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ kneel down (*☉౪⊙*)
Recent updates:
1 level editor (content module 100 +, too few, this will be added later) (level creative workshop will be opened as soon as possible)
2 two Laurie Heroes (recently made a new body shape and face, and then look at the previous protagonists are not satisfied, there will be new ones in the future)
All the characters' faces were changed into new faces
43 defense towers (cannon, flamethrower, magic tower)
Different arms have different barracks
6 UI icon optimization
7 optimization of exhibition stand
8 opening optimization (BGM replacement)
9. Add 8 entry level basic levels (some players find it difficult)
10 new test level module (some not rigorous but interesting levels will be put in later)
Optimization of hair dynamic skeleton of maid and Chinese lady
12 attack judgment ：is tied to the weapon before (if the machine runs slowly, there will be empty phenomenon) at present, it is the area in front of the hero, the area is larger, the attack is easier to control, and the enemy's attack time is the same, and it will be optimized in the later stage
13. The first three levels and the seventh level of natural desert level have been changed (the current level is rough as a whole. With the increase of editor modules, most of them may be redone)

notes.title: Adjust quality settings, repair RT key
notes.content:
1. (It is found that the screenshots and videos of some players have no shadow, and the default is the lowest effect.)
Adjusted the parameters of the quality setting, turned off the low-level setting anti-aliasing, turned on the shadow, and defaulted to the highest effect.
Press the P key to display FPS, refer to FPS to select the appropriate effect.
Detailed screen settings will be added later.
2. (Based on player feedback) Fixed a bug where the RT key of some controllers is always activated.
Thanks for reading (´; ω; ‘)

notes.title: Figure Simulator War major update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35933113/c58c665b6ed1dd47583787fe2831542e25165f6c.jpg[/img]

1 Added 2 heroines

2 Currently 6 heroes have added skills each
    There are shadow clones, big swords flying out of whirlwind chops, etc., not yet named 
(• ิ _ • ิ)
 
3 new units added
    Barracks, bomb cars, collision cars, mechs, dragons, burst skulls, medicine chests

4 Levels are divided into two modes
   (New mode) The enemy will produce units from barracks and arsenals. If the enemy is 
not destroyed in time, more and more troops will be out, similar to RTS.

   (Old mode) The enemy sends troops from the castle at a fixed rate, and the frequency of the troops is equivalent to the increase of the player's energy value.

     20 levels in the new mode and 16 levels in the old mode, for a total of 36 levels

5 Main interface animation, BGM replacement


Thank you for your attention and support ~~ Remove this plaything together (｡◕‿◕｡)
